query: What is SGAC or SG Arrival Card?
reference_answer: SG Arrival Card,  also known as SGAC is the electronic version of the paper Disembarkation/Embarkation (D/E) card that every foreign visitor must present for immigration clearance. A D/E number is provided to foreign visitors after SGAC submission.The submission of the SG Arrival Card is one of the basic entry requirements to visit Singapore. The use of the SG Arrival Card e-Service is free of charge. Please also note that the SG Arrival Card is not a visa.
answer: SGAC or SG Arrival Card is a form required by Immigration at Changi Airport in Singapore upon arrival to provide personal details and health information. [Document 1]
